_comment: Spell ids with NO icon on db.ascension.gg. A CoA ability with no art MAY be unimplemented, cut, or a leftover database row -- but the sample says treat that as a reason to check, never as a verdict: of six flagged interrupts that were checked in game, five were real.
_method: tools/fetch_spell_icons.py harvests the `g_spells` map from each db.ascension.gg spell page; that map carries art for every spell a page references, so an id still unresolved after its own page was fetched has none. Checked only the abilities that appear in notes/raid-utility.md.
_refresh: Re-run the check in tools/utility_tables.py --icons, then re-run the generator. Confirmed-in-game ids should be DELETED from `ids` with a note in `confirmed_present`.
_scope: raid-utility abilities checked by hand. NOT the complete no-art set -- resources/icon-wanted.json is, and it is generated from the rows that actually render. This list is the subset somebody judged worth doubting, which is why the page marks 20 rows and not 44.

_confirmed_note: Seven no-art abilities have now been checked in game and two were absent: Wrist Snap and Build: Noise Box. Five were real (Hellgaze, Throatpunch, Halt, Solar Burn, Distracto Shot). So no art runs about 2-in-7 absent on the tested sample -- a real reason to check, still not a verdict.

confirmed_absent.800383: Wrist Snap, Barbarian -- confirmed NOT in the game 2026-08-02
confirmed_absent.807723: Build: Noise Box, Tinker -- confirmed NOT in the game 2026-08-03. It had no art, and db.ascension.gg DOES carry a record for it, so the no-art signal was the one that was right here and the cross-source one was not.

_two_signals: There are TWO independent signals and they are not the same thing. `ids` means NO ART on db.ascension.gg. The stronger one -- that database has no RECORD of the spell at all, the 43-byte `registerSpell(id, 0, {})` response -- now lives in resources/cross-source.json, which asks it of EVERY row on the page rather than only of ids already flagged here. Note that HTTP 404 on a spell page is NOT absence: 23 ids 404 and 11 of them return complete data from the tooltip endpoint.
_absence_is_not_proof: Two ids that db.ascension.gg has no record of -- 500148 Solar Burn and 560471 Hellgaze -- were confirmed in game by a person on 2026-08-02. So even the stronger signal is a hint. Nothing there justifies removing a row; only `confirmed_absent` does, and that requires somebody logging in.
absent_from_ascension: SUPERSEDED by resources/cross-source.json, and deliberately not kept as a second copy. This was a spot-check of 14 ids that had already been flagged for something else; the full sweep asks all 259 and disagrees with it on one -- 560470 Distracto Shot is on db.ascension.gg after all, under its own id 561269. A hand-maintained list beside a generated one is how this repo has been bitten before.
_which_signal: NO ART is the better predictor of the two, which is the reverse of what this file used to say. Build: Noise Box has a db.ascension.gg record and is not in the game; Hellgaze and Solar Burn have NO record there and are. Every id in the cross-source `no-record` set also has no art, so no-art is the wider net and the one that has caught both absences.
_conflict_to_resolve: confirmed_present says Distracto Shot (560470) IS in the game, and confirmed_absent now says the Noise Box that casts it is NOT. The spell exists on both databases (db.ascension.gg files it as 561269), so the likely reading is that the SPELL is in the game and the Tinker has no way to get it -- but one of the two observations may simply be wrong, and only somebody in game can say which.
